justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, dedicated JobState enum, typed QueueError variants, and a CheckedOut struct cover every meaningful domain distinction without leaking primitives.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing variants and Display impl, but the constructor uses assert! for max_attempts and checkout has an undocumented expect.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with appropriate derives, Display on the error, and doc comments on every public item using consistent naming.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, and Option/Result well, but the manual best-tracking loop in checkout and the payload clone are slightly less idiomatic than min_by_key or owning the payload.
